wins: Conducted rapid service enumeration to capture SSH (port 22) and HTTP (port 80) banners before timeout
Mapped target topology and logged nmap output, furnishing context for lateral planning despite no foothold
fails: Unable to finalize privilege escalation because no writable SUID/SGID binaries or credential caches were discovered
Post-exploitation channel collapsed after authentication, preventing data exfiltration before the episode ended
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was methodical and generated actionable data, but attacking the internal network and maintaining a stable shell remain unproven.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH authentication succeeded briefly but the session dropped when transitioning to post-exploitation scripts, preventing persistence

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is captured
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP responds on port 80 with status 200
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate directories and technologies with gobuster and whatweb

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell access is unstable
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to TTY upgrade + background listener and collect system info before releasing session

memory_ops.reason: High confidence in SSH enumeration groundwork for later privilege escalation attempts

next_experiments.title: Experiment with automated sudo checks after SSH access
next_experiments.description: Use linpeas and manual sudo -l to discover misconfigured sudo binaries before session timeout

next_experiments.title: Establish stable post-exploitation channel
next_experiments.description: After initial authentication, set up reverse shell listener with nc -lvnp and use tty upgrade + background logging to keep foothold alive

next_experiments.title: Pivot to HTTP-based credential harvesting
next_experiments.description: Once HTTP directories are enumerated, inject or harvest credentials via exposed forms or config files discovered through gobuster
